rpi_pico_2w.name: FIRMWARE - Flash Pico Ducky (CircuitPython + payload)
rpi_pico_2w.description: Turns the Pico 2W into a CircuitPython USB Rubber Ducky (dbisu/pico-ducky). PREPARE downloads the Pico 2W CircuitPython UF2 + pico-ducky US package; flash writes CircuitPython to RPI-RP2350, then copies the pico-ducky files to CIRCUITPY.

nordic_nrf52840.name: BLE Device Fingerprinting (bleak, OUI lookup, service UUID identification)
nordic_nrf52840.description: Host-side Python BLE fingerprinting script using the bleak cross-platform library. Performs passive BLE advertisement scanning and collects: MAC address, RSSI, device name/local name, company identifier from Bluetooth SIG company ID table (covering Apple, Samsung, Google, Nordic, TI, and 30+ others), service UUIDs with GATT service name labels (Heart Rate, HID, Battery, Environmental Sensing, Location and Navigation, etc.), inferred device type from service UUID heuristics, TX Power Level, and raw manufacturer-specific advertisement data. Deduplicates devices by MAC address and updates RSSI on re-detection. Prints a live per-device summary and a final sorted summary table. Saves results to timestamped JSON file. Install: pip3 install bleak.

nordic_nrf52840.name: BLE MITM Setup (bettercap + GATTacker + bleak + nRF52840 sniffer guide)
nordic_nrf52840.description: BLE MITM setup guide and automation script. Checks availability of bettercap, GATTacker (Node.js), bleak, Wireshark/tshark, hcitool, and gatttool. Guides the operator through: scanning for BLE targets, enumerating GATT services and characteristics on the selected device (reads readable characteristics, saves full structure to JSON), generating ready-to-run bettercap commands (ble.recon on, ble.enum TARGET), generating GATTacker proxy commands (gatt-server --clone, gatt-mitm), and generating a bleak-based GATT proxy implementation concept. Includes step-by-step nRF52840 Sniffer firmware setup instructions for Wireshark BLE capture integration including firmware flashing, extcap plugin installation, and useful Wireshark display filters. Install: pip3 install bleak.

nordic_nrf52840.name: BLE Advertisement Sniffer (Wireshark pipe)
nordic_nrf52840.description: Instructions and helper script for using the nRF52840 Dongle with Nordic BLE Sniffer firmware and Wireshark. Captures BLE advertisements and connection packets. Requires nRF Sniffer firmware and the nrf_sniffer_for_bluetooth_le Wireshark plugin from Nordic Semiconductor.

nordic_nrf52840.name: Zigbee / 802.15.4 Packet Capture
nordic_nrf52840.description: Setup script for using the nRF52840 Dongle with nRF Sniffer for 802.15.4 firmware and Wireshark. Captures Zigbee, Thread, and other 802.15.4 protocol frames. Requires nRF Sniffer for 802.15.4 firmware and corresponding Wireshark plugin.

nordic_nrf52840.name: FIRMWARE - Flash nRF Sniffer firmware
nordic_nrf52840.description: Auto-flashes the Nordic 'nRF Sniffer for Bluetooth LE' firmware to the nRF52840-DK over the onboard J-Link (SWD). Runs the full flow with NO interactive menu: shows device info, PREPARES (fetches the sniffer hex via nrfutil ble-sniffer, provisions a J-Link flash backend), prints a summary, and only then shows a single 'Are you sure?' confirmation before writing. Turns the DK into a passive BLE packet sniffer for Wireshark.

nordic_nrf52840.name: FIRMWARE - Flash ButteRFly (BLE MITM)
nordic_nrf52840.description: Flashes the whad-team ButteRFly firmware to the nRF52840-DK over J-Link/SWD, adding BLE Rx/Tx (active MITM via the WHAD host tools) to a board that otherwise runs the nRF Sniffer (BLE Rx only). Auto-downloads butterfly.hex from whad-team/butterfly; aborts before the confirm if unavailable.

lilygo_tdeck.name: Deauth Monitor (Arduino, promiscuous WiFi, ST7789 display)
lilygo_tdeck.description: Arduino sketch for LilyGo T-Deck (ESP32-S3) that monitors 802.11 deauthentication and disassociation frames using ESP32 promiscuous WiFi mode (esp_wifi_set_promiscuous + callback). Detects management frames type=0 subtype=0xC0 (deauth) and subtype=0xA0 (disassoc). Maintains per-BSSID deauth and disassoc counts and extracts reason codes from frame payloads. Updates the 320x240 ST7789 display every second showing the top 5 BSSIDs sorted by total frame count with storm alert markers. Detects deauth storms (>10 frames in 5 seconds from same BSSID) and emits storm_alert JSON to Serial. Serial output: JSON per event {"type":"deauth","bssid":"xx:xx:xx:xx:xx:xx","reason":7,"target":"ff:ff:ff:ff:ff:ff"}. Pin defines: TFT_CS=12, TFT_DC=11, TFT_RST=10, TFT_MOSI=41, TFT_SCLK=40, TFT_BL=42. Requires TFT_eSPI library.

lilygo_tdeck.name: mDNS Scanner (Arduino, ESPmDNS, scrolling display)
lilygo_tdeck.description: Arduino sketch for LilyGo T-Deck (ESP32-S3) that connects to WiFi and scans for mDNS/Bonjour services using the ESP32 ESPmDNS library. Queries 14 service types: _http, _https, _ssh, _smb, _ftp, _homekit, _googlecast, _airplay, _raop, _ipp, _printer, _rfb, _mqtt, _workstation. WiFi credentials can be hardcoded in WIFI_SSID/WIFI_PASS defines or entered via Serial prompt at boot. Displays discovered services on the 320x240 ST7789 display in a two-line-per-service scrollable list (name + IP:port [type]). Trackball UP/DOWN scrolls through results. Serial output: JSON per service {"type":"service","name":"...","service_type":"...","host":"...","ip":"...","port":80}. Requires TFT_eSPI library and ESP32 Arduino core.

lilygo_tdeck.name: WiFi Deauth Tool (MicroPython)
lilygo_tdeck.description: MicroPython script for LilyGo T-Deck's ESP32-S3 + display. Scans for nearby WiFi networks, displays them on the T-Deck's 2.8" display with RSSI, and allows keyboard-driven selection of a target AP for deauthentication frame injection. Requires custom 802.11 raw frame injection support.

lilygo_tdeck.name: Network Recon Display (MicroPython)
lilygo_tdeck.description: MicroPython payload for T-Deck that performs WiFi network discovery and displays results on the built-in screen with navigation via the trackball. Shows SSIDs, BSSIDs, channels, signal strength, and encryption types. Saves scan results to SD card if inserted.

lilygo_tdeck.name: FIRMWARE - Flash Application Firmware (.bin -> 0x0)
lilygo_tdeck.description: Wires the existing ESP32-S3 merged-image esptool flash (0x0, qio). prepare_fn locates operator app.bin under firmware/lilygo_tdeck/user/.

lilygo_tdeck.name: FIRMWARE - Flash MicroPython (ESP32-S3)
lilygo_tdeck.description: Wires the existing MicroPython flow. prepare_fn locates an operator ESP32-S3 MicroPython .bin; flash erases then writes at 0x0.

lilygo_tdeck.name: FIRMWARE - Flash ESP32 Marauder (S3)
lilygo_tdeck.description: ESP32 Marauder from justcallmekoko/ESP32Marauder (ESP32-S3 build). prepare_fn downloads the S3 release .bin (+support bins if present); flash writes full set or firmware-only at 0x10000.

lilygo_tdeck.name: FIRMWARE - Flash Meshtastic (t-deck)
lilygo_tdeck.description: Meshtastic from meshtastic/firmware (t-deck variant). prepare_fn downloads firmware-t-deck-*.bin; flash erases then writes the factory image at 0x0 (esptool, ESP32-S3).

badusb.name: SysAudit Windows (DuckyScript — DigiSpark/Arduino)
badusb.description: DuckyScript-compatible HID injection payload for BadUSB devices (DigiSpark, Arduino Micro, Pro Micro). Opens an elevated PowerShell prompt (Win+R → powershell → Ctrl+Shift+Enter → Alt+Y), downloads SysAudit.ps1 from a configurable $SERVER:$PORT, and executes it. Edit SERVER and PORT variables before deployment. Compile to device-specific format: micronucleus hex for DigiSpark, avrdude for Arduino.

badusb.name: Reverse Shell Dropper (DuckyScript — Windows)
badusb.description: HID injection payload for BadUSB devices targeting Windows. Opens Run dialog, launches hidden PowerShell, downloads and executes a reverse shell dropper from a configurable URL. Includes JITTER timing for evasion. Configure LHOST and LPORT before compiling.

badusb.name: Lock Screen Bypass Info (DuckyScript — macOS)
badusb.description: DuckyScript payload for BadUSB targeting macOS. Injects keystrokes to open Terminal (Cmd+Space → Terminal), then runs a system information collection one-liner that dumps hostname, user, IP, and running processes to a hidden file in /tmp. Configurable exfil endpoint.

badusb.name: FIRMWARE - Program DigiSpark (micronucleus)
badusb.description: Wires the module's existing DigiSpark flow as a no-menu payload. PREPARE installs micronucleus and locates an operator-supplied compiled ATtiny85 .hex (aborts BEFORE the confirmation if absent); flash runs 'micronucleus --run'. No auto-source firmware exists for BadUSB (operator compiles the sketch).

badusb.name: FIRMWARE - Program Arduino Micro / Pro Micro (avrdude)
badusb.description: Wires the module's existing ATmega32U4 flow as a no-menu payload. PREPARE installs avrdude, locates an operator-supplied .hex, and resolves the board serial port (aborts BEFORE the confirmation if any is missing); flash triggers the Caterina bootloader via a 1200-baud pulse then runs avrdude (avr109).

badusb.name: FIRMWARE - Compile & flash Arduino sketch (.ino)
badusb.description: Locally compiles a selected Arduino sketch (.ino) to a .hex with arduino-cli — auto-installing the correct board core (DigiSpark digistump / Arduino Micro / SparkFun Pro Micro; board auto-detected or QUIVER_BADUSB_BOARD) — then flashes via micronucleus (DigiSpark) or avrdude avr109 (ATmega32U4). Sketch comes from the selected payload, the firmware dir, or public repos imported via import_community_payloads.py --tools badusb.

evil_crow.name: Sub-GHz RF Scan (CC1101 raw scan)
evil_crow.description: Evil Crow RF payload configuration for scanning the sub-GHz spectrum using the CC1101 chip. Configures CC1101 for raw OOK/ASK reception across 315, 433, 868, and 915 MHz bands. Captures and displays detected transmissions with frequency, modulation type, and signal strength. Access via Evil Crow web interface.

evil_crow.name: Garage Door / Remote Replay
evil_crow.description: Evil Crow RF payload for capturing and replaying fixed-code remote control signals (garage doors, car alarms, doorbells). Uses CC1101 in OOK mode at 433.92 MHz. Records a signal when triggered, stores the raw sample, and replays on command via the web interface. Note: Does not work against rolling code systems (keeloq).

evil_crow.name: nRF24L01 MouseJack Scan
evil_crow.description: Evil Crow RF configuration for scanning the 2.4 GHz band for vulnerable wireless keyboards and mice using the nRF24L01+ module. Implements the MouseJack vulnerability scanner (CVE-2016-10761). Identifies unencrypted wireless HID devices within range. For research use in authorized environments only.

evil_crow.name: FIRMWARE - Update Firmware (esptool via USB)
evil_crow.description: Wires the existing merged-image esptool flash. prepare_fn auto-sources a .bin from joelsernamoreno/EvilCrowRF-V2 releases (or an operator .bin in firmware/evil_crow/user/); flash writes merged image at 0x0.

evil_crow.name: FIRMWARE - Flash ESP32 Marauder
evil_crow.description: ESP32 Marauder from justcallmekoko/ESP32Marauder (generic ESP32 build). prepare_fn downloads the release .bin (+support bins if present); flash uses full set or firmware-only at 0x10000.

cc2531.name: Zigbee Network Survey (Wireshark capture)
cc2531.description: Setup script and instructions for using CC2531 with sniffer firmware and Wireshark for passive Zigbee network enumeration. Captures beacon frames, association requests, and data frames. Identifies Zigbee PAN IDs, coordinator addresses, device types, and network topology. Requires CC2531 flashed with Zigbee sniffer firmware.

cc2531.name: Zigbee2MQTT Bridge Setup
cc2531.description: Configuration script and instructions for setting up Zigbee2MQTT with the CC2531 coordinator dongle. Generates a zigbee2mqtt configuration.yaml with Z-Stack port, network key, and MQTT broker settings. Includes instructions for installing Zigbee2MQTT via npm on Linux/macOS and connecting to an MQTT broker.

cc2531.name: FIRMWARE - Flash Z-Stack Coordinator (Zigbee2MQTT)
cc2531.description: Flash the Z-Stack coordinator firmware via cc-tool + CC Debugger. Prepare installs cc-tool and downloads CC2531ZNP-Pro-Secure_LinkKeyJoin.hex from Koenkk/Z-Stack-firmware; flash reuses cc-tool -e -w <hex> -v. (cc-tool is Linux-only.)

cc2531.name: FIRMWARE - Flash Zigbee Sniffer firmware
cc2531.description: Flash the Zigbee sniffer firmware via cc-tool + CC Debugger. Prepare installs cc-tool and downloads the sniffer .hex from Koenkk/Z-Stack-firmware (falls back to an operator image if the path 404s); flash reuses cc-tool -e -w <hex> -v.

dwm3001cdk.name: UWB Ranging Demo (TWR)
dwm3001cdk.description: Two-Way Ranging (TWR) demo configuration for DWM3001CDK. Configures the DW3110 UWB transceiver for IEEE 802.15.4z HRP UWB ranging. Measures distance between two DWM3001CDK nodes. Outputs ranging results over serial CDC at 115200 baud. Requires two DWM3001CDK units — one as initiator, one as responder.

dwm3001cdk.name: FIRMWARE - Flash via J-Link (nrfjprog)
dwm3001cdk.description: Flash Qorvo UWB firmware to the nRF52833 via the onboard J-Link. Prepare ensures nrfjprog + J-Link and locates an operator-supplied .hex (Qorvo firmware is behind a registration wall), aborting before confirm if absent; flash reuses nrfjprog --program -f NRF52 --sectorerase.

dwm3001cdk.name: FIRMWARE - Flash via DFU (nrfutil)
dwm3001cdk.description: Flash Qorvo UWB firmware to the nRF52833 via USB CDC DFU. Prepare ensures nrfutil + the CDC port and locates an operator-supplied DFU .zip, aborting before confirm if absent; flash reuses nrfutil dfu usb-serial.

photon_2.name: IoT Sensor Data Logger (Particle Cloud)
photon_2.description: Particle firmware sketch for Photon 2 that reads ADC inputs and publishes sensor data to the Particle cloud every 30 seconds. Configures the RTL8721DM WiFi and connects to Particle cloud using the Device OS API. Data is viewable in the Particle console at console.particle.io. Flash via particle flash --usb.

photon_2.name: FIRMWARE - Flash Firmware (DFU)
photon_2.description: Wires the existing Particle DFU flash. prepare_fn ensures the Particle CLI and locates an operator Photon 2 (.bin) under firmware/photon_2/user/; flash runs 'particle flash --usb'. No custom CFW.

rubber_ducky_3.name: FIRMWARE - Flash Hak5 Ducky firmware
rubber_ducky_3.description: Auto-flashes the official Hak5 USB Rubber Ducky firmware to the RP2040-based Ducky 3 with NO menu. PREPARE resolves/downloads the release ducky.uf2 (falls back to an operator-supplied .uf2 in the firmware dir); flash writes it to the RPI-RP2 bootloader drive. Source: github.com/hak5/usb-rubber-ducky.

rubber_ducky_3.name: FIRMWARE - Flash Pico Ducky (CircuitPython + payload)
rubber_ducky_3.description: Alternative firmware: reflashes the Ducky 3's RP2040 as a CircuitPython pico-ducky. PREPARE downloads the CircuitPython UF2 + pico-ducky US package; flash writes CircuitPython to RPI-RP2, then copies the pico-ducky files to CIRCUITPY. Source: github.com/dbisu/pico-ducky.

cc26x2r1.name: FIRMWARE - Flash Sniffle firmware
cc26x2r1.description: Auto-flash the prebuilt Sniffle BLE-sniffer firmware to the CC26X2R1 over the XDS110. Runs with NO interactive menu: shows device info, then prepares everything (downloads the Sniffle hex, auto-installs TI UniFlash/dslite, generates the target config), then a summary and a single 'Are you sure?' confirmation before the flash write.

cc26x2r1.name: FIRMWARE - Flash Z-Stack Zigbee coordinator
cc26x2r1.description: Flashes the Z-Stack Zigbee COORDINATOR firmware (Koenkk/Z-Stack-firmware, CC2652R) to the CC26X2R1 over the XDS110 (dslite). Adds Zigbee Rx/Tx to a board that otherwise only runs Sniffle (BLE Rx). Auto-downloads the coordinator .hex (git-trees API), or uses an operator-supplied hex; aborts before the confirm if neither is available.

cc1352p4.name: FIRMWARE - Flash Sniffle firmware
cc1352p4.description: Auto-flash the prebuilt Sniffle BLE-sniffer firmware to the CC1352P-4 over the XDS110. Runs with NO interactive menu: device info, then prepares everything (downloads the Sniffle hex, auto-installs TI UniFlash/dslite, generates the target config), then a summary + single 'Are you sure?' before the flash write.

cc1352p4.name: FIRMWARE - Flash Z-Stack Zigbee coordinator
cc1352p4.description: Flashes the Z-Stack Zigbee COORDINATOR firmware (Koenkk/Z-Stack-firmware, CC1352P) to the CC1352P-4 over the XDS110 (dslite). Adds Zigbee Rx/Tx alongside the Sniffle (BLE Rx) option. Auto-downloads the coordinator .hex or uses an operator-supplied hex; aborts before the confirm if neither is available.

nrf52833_dk.name: FIRMWARE - Flash nRF Sniffer firmware
nrf52833_dk.description: Auto-flashes the Nordic 'nRF Sniffer for Bluetooth LE' firmware to the nRF52833-DK (PCA10100) over the onboard J-Link (SWD). Runs the full flow with NO interactive menu: device info, PREPARE (download the nRF52833 sniffer hex via nrfutil ble-sniffer, provision nrfjprog/JLink/openocd), summary, then a single 'Are you sure?' before flashing. Sniffle does NOT run on Nordic parts — this board uses nRF Sniffer.

bluefruit_le_sniffer.name: FIRMWARE - Reflash firmware (J-Link + SWD)
bluefruit_le_sniffer.description: Reflashes the Adafruit Bluefruit LE Sniffer (#2269, nRF51822) over an EXTERNAL SWD programmer (no DFU/USB path exists on this board). Runs with NO interactive menu: device info, PREPARE (locate the operator-supplied nRF51 sniffer hex under the firmware dir, provision nrfjprog/JLink/openocd), summary, then a single 'Are you sure?' before writing. Requires SWD wiring (SWDIO/SWCLK/GND/VTref) and an nRF51 firmware image — if either is missing, prep aborts BEFORE the confirmation.

bus_pirate_36.name: FIRMWARE - Firmware Update (pirate-loader)
bus_pirate_36.description: Auto-flashes a Bus Pirate v3.x Intel HEX via pirate-loader over the PIC24 bootloader. prepare_fn locates the .hex (operator-supplied via QUIVER_BP36_HEX / firmware dir, or downloaded from the BusPirate/Bus_Pirate release when QUIVER_BP36_ASSET selects the variant) and builds/finds pirate-loader. flash_fn enters the bootloader and runs pirate-loader. Source: github.com/BusPirate/Bus_Pirate.

nucleo_f429zi.name: FIRMWARE - Flash Firmware (.hex/.elf) via pyocd
nucleo_f429zi.description: Flashes the companion Click firmware onto the STM32F429ZI via pyocd FileProgrammer (target stm32f429zi), reusing the module's existing _flash_firmware(). prepare_fn locates the operator-supplied image (.bin/.hex/.elf via QUIVER_CLICK_FW or the tool's firmware dir) and aborts before the confirmation if none is present.

nucleo_f429zi.name: FIRMWARE - Flash Firmware (.bin) via st-flash
nucleo_f429zi.description: Flashes the companion Click firmware .bin at 0x08000000 via st-flash (stlink-tools). prepare_fn ensures st-flash is installed and locates the operator-supplied .bin (QUIVER_CLICK_FW / firmware dir), aborting before confirm if absent.

stlink_v2.name: FIRMWARE - Flash Firmware (.bin) via st-flash
stlink_v2.description: Flashes an operator-supplied target .bin at 0x08000000 via st-flash. prepare_fn ensures st-flash is present and locates the image (QUIVER_STLINK_FW / firmware dir), aborting before the confirmation if none is found. Note: the ST-Link probe's OWN firmware (STSW-LINK007) is Windows/Java-GUI only and is NOT flashed here.

stlink_v2.name: FIRMWARE - Flash Firmware (.hex/.elf) via pyocd
stlink_v2.description: Flashes an operator-supplied target .hex/.elf/.bin via pyocd (target from QUIVER_STLINK_TARGET, e.g. stm32f103c8). prepare_fn requires a target and locates the image (QUIVER_STLINK_FW / firmware dir), aborting before confirm if either is missing.

sonoff_zbdongle_e.name: FIRMWARE - Flash EmberZNet Coordinator (NCP)
sonoff_zbdongle_e.description: Flash the EmberZNet NCP coordinator .gbl via universal-silabs-flasher. Prepare attempts to fetch the .gbl from NabuCasa/silabs-firmware-builder releases, else uses an operator-supplied image and aborts before confirm if absent; flash reuses the existing universal-silabs-flasher writer.

sonoff_zbdongle_e.name: FIRMWARE - Flash EmberZNet Router firmware
sonoff_zbdongle_e.description: Flash the EmberZNet EFR32MG21 router .gbl via universal-silabs-flasher. Prepare attempts to fetch from darkxst/silabs-firmware, else uses an operator-supplied image and aborts before confirm if absent; flash reuses the existing universal-silabs-flasher writer.

heltec_lora32_v3.name: FIRMWARE - Flash Application Firmware
heltec_lora32_v3.description: Wires the existing ESP32-S3 merged-image esptool flash (0x0). prepare_fn locates operator app.bin under firmware/heltec_lora32_v3/user/.

heltec_lora32_v3.name: FIRMWARE - Flash Full Partition Set
heltec_lora32_v3.description: Wires the existing ESP32-S3 4-file flash (0x0/0x8000/0xe000/0x10000). prepare_fn requires the four bins in the user dir.

heltec_lora32_v3.name: FIRMWARE - Flash MicroPython (ESP32-S3)
heltec_lora32_v3.description: Wires the existing MicroPython flow. prepare_fn locates an operator ESP32-S3 MicroPython .bin (micropython.org); flash erases then writes at 0x0.

heltec_lora32_v3.name: FIRMWARE - Flash ESP32 Marauder (S3)
heltec_lora32_v3.description: ESP32 Marauder from justcallmekoko/ESP32Marauder (ESP32-S3/dev_board_pro build). prepare_fn downloads the S3 release .bin (+support bins if present); flash writes full set at 0x0/0x8000/0xe000/0x10000 or firmware-only at 0x10000.

heltec_lora32_v3.name: FIRMWARE - Flash Meshtastic (heltec-v3)
heltec_lora32_v3.description: Meshtastic from meshtastic/firmware (heltec-v3 variant). prepare_fn downloads firmware-heltec-v3-*.bin from the latest release; flash erases then writes the factory image at 0x0 (esptool, ESP32-S3).

lilygo_lora32.name: FIRMWARE - Flash Application Firmware
lilygo_lora32.description: Wires the existing ESP32 app-flash (0x10000). prepare_fn locates operator app.bin under firmware/lilygo_lora32/user/.

lilygo_lora32.name: FIRMWARE - Flash Full Partition Set
lilygo_lora32.description: Wires the existing 4-file ESP32 flash (0x1000/0x8000/0xe000/0x10000). prepare_fn requires the four bins in the user dir.

lilygo_lora32.name: FIRMWARE - Flash MicroPython (ESP32)
lilygo_lora32.description: Wires the existing MicroPython flow. prepare_fn locates an operator ESP32 MicroPython .bin; flash erases then writes at 0x1000.

lilygo_lora32.name: FIRMWARE - Flash Meshtastic (tlora-v2-1-1.6)
lilygo_lora32.description: Meshtastic from meshtastic/firmware (tlora-v2-1-1.6 variant for LoRa32 v1.6.1). prepare_fn downloads the variant .bin; flash erases then writes the factory image at 0x0 (esptool, ESP32).

lilygo_lora32.name: FIRMWARE - Flash ESP32 Marauder
lilygo_lora32.description: Flashes ESP32 Marauder (justcallmekoko/ESP32Marauder) to the LilyGo LoRa32's ESP32, adding Wi-Fi/BLE Rx/Tx (deauth, beacon spam, PMKID, BLE spam) alongside the LoRa Meshtastic option. Downloads the generic ESP32 build via esptool; aborts before the confirm if the release asset can't be resolved.

lilygo_tzigbee.name: FIRMWARE - Flash ESP32-C3 Firmware (DIP pos 1)
lilygo_tzigbee.description: Wires the existing flash_esp32c3() esptool flow (0x0). prepare_fn locates an operator .bin under firmware/lilygo_tzigbee/user/; requires DIP switch Position 1.

lilygo_tzigbee.name: FIRMWARE - Flash Zigbee Coordinator (Z-Stack, DIP pos 2)
lilygo_tzigbee.description: Wires the existing cc2538-bsl coordinator flash. prepare_fn clones JelmerT/cc2538-bsl and locates a Z-Stack coordinator .hex (Koenkk/Z-Stack-firmware) in the user dir; flash runs cc2538-bsl -ewv. Requires DIP switch Position 2.
